name: hgi_qdq_lg_v6_ref-v6-COMMIT
purpose: Re-kit of the gate-clean QUANT LG port group (BANKS 2, kit hgi_qdq_lg_pg2 at 259.2x43.2) into the H-DIE v6 slot quant_NW*_lg 64.8 x 194.4 with the die-granted pins (36b341b5b: VM ports E, engine side W, 1,110 bits a side at 0.096 um/bit, clk/rst N). Same RTL; registered bank-pair near-tap stage (+2 read/+1 write in the exact bench, 152 vs immutable 168).

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_hgi_qdq_lg_port_group #(.BANKS(2)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/qw/static/ot_hgi_qdq_lg_port_group.sv && echo lint-ok

bench.name: QDQ_LG_exact
bench.cmd: IO_REGS=1 LG=1 TSPLIT=1 bash tools/hgi_unit_tput/run_qdq_static.sh {RUN}/bench_lg && cat {RUN}/bench_lg/m0.log

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/hgi_qdq_lg_v6_ref/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/hgi_qdq_lg_v6_ref/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/hgi_qdq_lg_v6_ref --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_hgi_qdq_lg_port_group  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run
